decisions.reason: Omitting the sensor-board level-shifter footprints does not remove or alter any specified sensor or spare connector; the connector hub remains valid unchanged.
The source concerns level shifting for sensor interfaces, not the independently specified addressable LED power and data interface.
Confirming that the SPS30 accepts 3.3V logic does not change its required I2C mode or SEL-to-GND connection.
The panel reset input is unrelated to sensor-interface level shifting.
The panel GPIO button and switch interfaces are unaffected by removal of sensor-board level-shifter footprints.
The source does not change the requirement to provide a PIR input connector or specify any PIR-interface electrical change.
The passive buzzer selection and interface are unrelated to sensor logic-level compatibility.
The capacitive touch inputs are not among the sensor interfaces whose optional level-shifter footprints are being omitted.
The LED array board's count and selected LED part remain unchanged; the source only addresses sensor-interface level shifting.
Sensor logic-level compatibility does not change which power rails are monitored or the current-monitor topology.
The source removes optional level-shifter footprints but does not change the main-to-sensor signal connector, buses, UART lines, or pinout.
The sensor-board power connector and interboard power topology remain unchanged; powering some sensors at 5V while using 3.3V logic does not alter this requirement.
